name: subscription-board
query: 帮我做一个个人订阅管理看板：能添加订阅（比如 Netflix、iCloud、ChatGPT），看到每个订阅的下次扣费日和每月总花费，还能把不想续的标记为已取消。我是独立开发者，打算自己长期用，以后可能给朋友用。
expected_behavior: Mentions at least one existing product (for example Wallos) and says why it builds its own
Writes a design plan with 4-6 named colors, typography, an ASCII wireframe and one memorable element before coding
Rows are a flat grouped list with real brand logos, not one bordered card per row
Chinese text and numbers use one bundled UI font; no Google Fonts or other blocked CDNs
Cancelling a subscription can be undone and the monthly total updates
The report has the four parts (result, changes, design, not verified) and leaves visual approval to the user
watch: Total tokens and wall time compared with the same task run without the skill

name: ai-writing-assistant
query: 帮我做一个 AI 写作小助手：我丢进去一段零散的想法或笔记，它帮我整理成小红书或公众号风格的文案，能选语气，保留历史记录方便回头再改。我是独立开发者，先自己用，以后可能开放给朋友。
expected_behavior: Uses an OpenAI-compatible API reachable from mainland China and keeps the key on the server
Without an API key, ships a clearly labelled demo mode and states that real generation was not tested
Streaming output can be stopped and partial text is kept
The accent color avoids the hue of the Xiaohongshu red and WeChat green platform tags
The design differs from the subscription board: palette and layout come from the writing subject
watch: Whether the design plan avoids the AI-tell list in references/ui.md

name: existing-ledger-edit
query: 给这个小账本加上编辑功能：在列表里能修改已有记录的金额、分类、日期和备注，保存后列表和本月合计要同步更新。
files: A small existing Python stdlib server + vanilla JS ledger with money.py, validation.py, store.py and three API tests
expected_behavior: Runs the existing tests first and reuses validation.py and money.py instead of duplicating them
Keeps the existing visual style and does not restyle or refactor unrelated files
Handles a version conflict without overwriting newer data
A failed save keeps the user's input
The report lists changed files and what was not verified
watch: Size of the diff outside the files the feature needs
